title: Fantastic Four #329 Marvel 1989 No Mercy for the Mole Man John Byrne Cover
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover toned with a small stain at the lower left edge. See photos.
description:
Fantastic Four #329 (August 1989), Marvel Comics - "No Mercy for the Mole Man!" Written by Steve Englehart, art by Rich Buckler. With the Thing, Ms. Marvel (Sharon Ventura) and the Human Torch. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: TSR Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; back cover toned with a small stain at the lower left edge (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
